text:
oliver: Hey finance team - i lost the itemized receipt for a dinner in berlin on 2026-03-02. total on card was 0 68.50 EUR. it was a group dinner with a vendor but the restaurant gave one crumpled receipt and i left mine in the taxi. can i still expense this?

rachael_finance: hey @oliver - you can file but we need either an itemized receipt or a manager attestation for lost receipts. since this is a foreign currency charge and VAT reclaim may be possible, try to get a copy of the restaurant invoice from them. if not available we handle as "missing receipt" per policy.

oliver: got it. I emailed the restaurant asking for a duplicate invoice. in the meantime should i submit as per-diem or actuals? per-diem for berlin is 0 50/day per our travel matrix.

rachael_finance: because your corporate card was charged, we prefer actuals where possible. submit the actual amount (68.50 EUR) and attach: 1) bank statement line showing the charge, 2) copy of the missing-receipt form (link below), and 3) manager attestation. if the restaurant can't provide an invoice we'll process reimbursement but we won't reclaim VAT.

oliver: link to missing receipt form?

rachael_finance: https://expenses.redwood.company/missing-receipt. in the form select "Group meal - lost receipt" and include attendees + business purpose. also call out any alcohol on the bill.

oliver: there was a bottle of wine but the line item total doesn't isolate it. how do i handle alcohol cap?

rachael_finance: policy: alcohol is allowed up to the per-meal cap; any excess is non-reimbursable. if itemized amounts are not available, manager must attest to approximate alcohol portion. include that estimate in the missing-receipt form. we'll apply the per-meal cap (see https://policies.redwood.company/travel-per-diem#meal-caps).

tom_manager: i attended this dinner. i confirm work purpose and attendees (Acme systems: Petra + Jonas; Redwood: tom_manager + oliver). i attest that alcohol was moderate and within cap. i approve reimbursement pending duplicate invoice attempt.

rachael_finance: thanks @tom_manager - please include that attestation in the expense app under "Manager comments". oliver, when you submit pick Payment method = Corporate Card, Amount = 68.50 EUR, Receipt status = Lost - Missing Receipt Form TR-2026-221 attached. attach the bank statement screenshot and the manager attestation text.

oliver: submitted the expense and uploaded the bank statement + manager note. i also attached my email to the restaurant asking for the invoice.

opsbot: Ticket created: TR-2026-221. Labels: missing-receipt, group-meal. Please escalate if restaurant does not reply after 5 business days.

rachael_finance: we'll hold VAT reclaim until we get the invoice. processing reimbursement now as gross amount. reimbursements for foreign currency charges use the card settled USD amount as authoritative; include both EUR and USD values in the expense line.

oliver: thanks! one more Q: if the restaurant provides a duplicate invoice that lists VAT, can finance perform VAT reclaim retroactively?

rachael_finance: yes, if we receive a compliant VAT invoice within 60 days we can attempt reclaim. attach the invoice to the same expense and comment TR-2026-221. otherwise, we close the ticket and reimburse gross.

opsbot: Reminder scheduled: follow up on TR-2026-221 in 5 business days.
